task.title: Creating Offline Agreements
task.shortdesc: Offline Agreements can be created directly in X-Author Contracts, by taking a pre-existing Microsoft Word

context.p: Offline Agreements can be created directly in X-Author Contracts, by taking a pre-existing Microsoft Word document that was created outside of CRM and has not previously been associated with an Agreement and checking it in. When you have a document without Apttus properties open in Microsoft Word and you can create a new agreement record by checking it in as an offline agreement.
